messages:
jordan (acct-cust): hey, hitting a regression since ~09:00 UTC — our JSON-mode function calls that expect an array are failing validation and our client is retrying a lot. billing spike.

jordan (acct-cust): payload we send (via our api-gw):
```json
{"order_ids": "", "metadata": {"source":"mobile"}}
```

maria (support): thanks — can you paste the function schema the runtime expects? and sdk/version you used?

jordan (acct-cust): schema on their side (function declaration):
```json
{"name":"attach_items","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"order_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"metadata":{"type":"object"}},"required":["order_ids"]}}
```

jordan (acct-cust): sdk: redwood-js v0.9.2, requests proxied through our gateway (company-gw v2.3.1). note: gateway recently had a change that stringifies empty arrays.

kevin (eng-sre): log from runtime when validation fails:
```
2025-09-02T09:01:12Z validation_error: order_ids: expected array, got string
request_id=01FZQ... retry_count=3
```

ingrid (sdk): repro curl that mimics gateway behaviour:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/func/invoke \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Forwarded-For: 1.2.3.4" \
  -d '{"order_ids":"","metadata":{"source":"mobile"}}'
```

maria (support): ok this looks like shape drift caused by the gateway converting empty arrays to empty strings. that explains required key present but wrong type -> runtime rejects -> client retries -> billing.

jordan (acct-cust): any quick mitigations? can we set a server-side tolerance for coercing string->array for empty values?

kevin (eng-sre): short term: add a proxy rule to map empty-string -> [] for the order_ids path. long term: gateway should stop coercing. we'll open an investigation ticket with platform.

maria (support): tagging @finance — customer reports billing spike due to retries. can we credit excess token/meters during investigation?

deploy-bot: deploy company-gw v2.3.2 rolled 2h ago (change: serialize-empty-arrays -> stringify). commit: a1b2c3

kevin (eng-sre): action items:
- eng-platform: roll back or patch gateway to preserve arrays (P0)
- eng-ml/serving: consider a permissive parse mode for structured function args that normalizes empty-string->empty-array for known array fields (opt-in) (P1)
- support: monitor billing anomalies and stage credits if spike > $1000

maria (support): jordan — can you run the curl repro and paste the runtime request-id from logs? we'll attach to the ticket.

jordan (acct-cust): ran repro, got request_id=01FZQABCD. attaching app logs and gateway trace in the ticket now.

ingrid (sdk): note for SDK patch: add a validator that pre-normalizes common edgecases when json_mode=true — but keep strict default.

maria (support): thanks — escalating to eng-platform and eng-ml. will follow up with timeline. :thumbsup:
